lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, with the primary circular blobs positioned at the intersection points of these bands and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper visible flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from light upper pixels to shadowed lower pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of smaller, lower-intensity luminance points on the cephalic region, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the flank.
